capabilities: Group tasks into color-coded projects on a board with Backlog, Today and Done columns
Plan and drag tasks on a monthly calendar switching between planned dates and deadlines
Create daily, weekly and monthly recurring tasks that generate successors after completion
Search, filter, sort, duplicate and manually archive tasks with undo support
Store task and project data as Markdown files in the vault with per-file backups
extras: Free edition of a larger plugin: automatic archiving, retention settings and custom board columns are not included. README warns to back up the vault before upgrading and not to run both editions simultaneously.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in board or calendar view for managing tasks and projects, and many task tools require accounts, network access, or cloud services.
summary: Local task board and monthly calendar that manages tasks and projects, storing all data as Markdown files in the vault.
